hub.headline: Sony's official PlayStation development tools, including SDevTC and the Net Yaroze hobbyist kit.
hub.next: Point readers to PSn00bSDK and write one page that maps the Sony tools to their open replacements.
hub.what_it_was: SDevTC was Sony's development toolchain for the original PlayStation, formerly known as Psy-Q; its manual dates from August 1998. Net Yaroze came with its own user, startup, library and MIPS reference documentation. Sony also shipped runtime library discs such as Programmer Tool Runtime Library 3.3.
hub.what_survives: The Sony SDK is not public, and the manuals and discs appear here only as archive listings. PSn00bSDK is a maintained open-source PlayStation SDK under MPL-2.0 (some sub-tools are GPL) that replaces the Sony libraries without using their files.

name: PS1 Programmer's Tool / SDevTC / Net Yaroze
summary: Public records now track SDevTC, Net Yaroze documentation, Redump disc metadata, and PSn00bSDK as the open compatibility lane.
